content.accountNote: New account · Joined today · 0 friends in common
content.message: hey its me Sam!! i lost my old account so this is my new one
content.message2: can u do me a quick favour? buy a $50 gift card and send me the code. ill pay u back tomorrow i promise. dont tell ur parents its a surprise

do.text: You sent the code. It was spent in seconds, and the money is gone. The real Sam never asked for it.

ignore.text: You didn't send anything. But the real Sam never finds out someone copied their account, and the fake keeps messaging other friends.

tell.text: Mum helped you call Sam's family. They reported the fake account, and it was taken down. Scam stopped!

buddy.intro: A message from a new account. Let's take a look.

do.text: Uh oh. Let's see what went wrong.

ignore.text: You're safe, but the fake Sam is still out there.

tell.text: Great job! Telling a grown-up stopped the fake account!

stop.text: 'Quick favour' was trying to make you act fast without thinking.

check.text: This account is brand new. Anyone can make an account with your friend's name.
'I lost my account' is a trick scammers use a lot.
Asking for a gift card code is a big warning sign. Gift cards are just like cash.
A real friend would never ask you to keep secrets from your parents.

recap.tell: Show a grown-up and say: 'Someone says they're Sam on a new account and wants a gift card. Can we check?'
